title: Home office built-in
description:
We turned an unused corner into a full-width oak desk with storage above and below, wired for two monitors.

The owners asked for **no visible cables**, so we ran power and data inside the cabinetry.

quote.text: The new desk changed how I work from home.
quote.name: Marcus B.

imageAlt: The finished built-in desk, with a large monitor and a lamp beside the window

seoDescription: A built-in oak desk with hidden wiring turns an unused corner of a Springfield home into a full office.
